EN:
On the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Winter Solstice{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} we have the
longest night of the year. The sun
won't come up at all today!
After tonight,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0003:0014:}}prepare for the bitter
cold{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:001C:}}Are you ready to be chilled to
the bone,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
ES:
En el solsticio de invierno coinciden{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
el día más corto y la noche más
larga del año,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} ¡dos por uno!
Lo peor del invierno llegará{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} a partir
de mañana{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0023:}}Espero que tengas
ropa de abrigo,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
FR:
Le solstice d'hiver,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} c'est à la fois le
jour le plus court et la nuit la plus
longue de l'année.
{{TAG:0003:002C:}}Dès demain,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} place aux glaciales
journées d'hiver{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Alors, t'es prêt{{TAG:000E:0006:000002006500}} à te déguiser en
doudoune ambulante, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ?
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Hé hé.
DE:
An {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Mittwinter {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}haben wir nicht nur
den kürzesten Tag, sondern auch
die längste Nacht des Jahres!
Ab heute kommt der Winter mit
voller Wucht...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0023:}}Bist du darauf
vorbereitet, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?

{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Kış Gündönümünde{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} yılın en uzun gecesini

Bu geceden sonra,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0003:0014:}}keskin soğuğa hazırlan{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}

{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}This night just won't let up,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} so that
means we'll have a lot of time to
gaze up at the stars.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}I have a feeling if we wish on the
stars tonight,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} they may really come
true{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}What's your wish,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Esta noche va a ser más larga que
un día sin pan.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} O que una noche
sin pan, que viene mejor al caso.
Aunque también tiene su lado bueno.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
Hay muchas más horas para
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}contemplar el cielo y pedir deseos{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}On va avoir une nuit très longue
aujourd'hui,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} de quoi prendre tout
son temps pour admirer les étoiles.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}C'est l'occasion ou jamais de faire
un vœu,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} et il se réalisera peut-être{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Tu souhaites quoi, toi, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}} ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Questa notte sarà lunghissima
{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}e avremo un sacco di tempo
per mirar las estrellas!
Forse, se esprimiamo un desiderio
stanotte,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} potrebbe avverarsi{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Tu che desiderio hai,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Heute wird die Nacht ziemlich lang,
also haben wir viel Zeit, um die
Sterne zu beobachten.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Ich hab irgendwie das Gefühl, dass
uns die Sterne heute Nacht unsere
Wünsche erfüllen werden...
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Was wünschst du dir, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bu gece bir türlü bitmiyor,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} demek ki yıldızlara
bakmak için bolca vaktimiz olacak.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}İçimden bir ses bu gece yıldızlardan dilek
tutarsak,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} gerçekten
gerçekleşebileceğini söylüyor{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Senin dileğin ne,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?

ES:
Mucha gente se suele dar un baño
bien caliente el día del solsticio
de invierno. ¿Lo sabías, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Si no recuerdo mal, es costumbre
echar algo en la bañera para
purificarse...{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}} ¿Qué era?
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Como no me acuerdo,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} yo le echaré

{{TAG:0003:0025:}}y por lo menos oleré bien.

EN:
So to get lots of vitamins,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} they say 
we should eat a ton of pumpkins
right before the solstice{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}But I don't see any pumpkins around
town at this time of year!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Oh well.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I think I'll just eat {{TAG:000E:0002:}}
{{TAG:0005:001A:00CD}} to get my vitamins
for now,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
Las calabazas son típicas del
invierno y además tienen un montón
de vitaminas.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}¡Lo malo es que no he visto ninguna
en el pueblo!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Se deben de haber
agotado o algo así.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Como no pienso quedarme sin mi
ración de vitaminas,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} me comeré
{{TAG:000E:0002:}}{{TAG:0005:001A:00CD}} más tarde.
FR:
Pour faire le plein de vitamines,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
faut manger un max de citrouilles
juste avant le solstice d'hiver{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Enfin, c'est ce qu'on dit{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}Mais
franchement, j'ai jamais vu la
moindre citrouille dans cette ville !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Alors tant pis,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} je vais juste manger
{{TAG:000E:0002:}}{{TAG:0005:001A:00CD}} et j'espère que
ça fera l'affaire,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
Si dice che, per assumere un bel po'
di vitamine,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} bisognerebbe mangiare
molta zucca prima del solstizio{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ma io non ho mai visto delle zucche
qui in città! Donde le trovo?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Oh pazienza,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} continuerò a mangiare
{{TAG:000E:0002:}}{{TAG:0005:001A:00CD}} al giorno.
Penso che basti,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

Kürbisse essen soll, um sich für den

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Are you as freaked out as I am to
have such a long, dark night all day
long,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Well, I'm actually{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} not THAT scared,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} Do you know why?
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Because you're here with me!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ah! No! Don't leave!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}¿No te da un poco de miedo que
hoy sea la noche más larga de todo
el año,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}A mí no me gusta que haya{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} tantas
horas de oscuridad.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Vete a saber
qué puede acechar en la sombra.
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}En fin, menos mal que estás tú
aquí para protegerm... {{TAG:0003:000D:}}Digo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. 
Para hacerme compañía.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Entre nous, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}c'est pas

{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Mais, euh, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}t'éloigne pas trop, OK ?

{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} E sai perché?
